name.title: Name
name.description: The name (title) of the Slack List to create, e.g. 'Sprint Tasks'. This is shown as the List's title in Slack and is required.
name.human_parameter_description: The title to give the new Slack List.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: Column definitions for the List. Each entry is a column object describing a typed column (its `name`, `type`, and any type-specific options such as `select` choices). Supported column types include `text`, `select`, `user`, `date`, `number`, `checkbox`, and others. Omit to create a List with Slack's default columns.
schema.human_parameter_description: The columns the List should have, each with a name and a type (such as text, select, user, date, number, or checkbox).

todo_mode.title: Todo Mode
todo_mode.description: Set to true to create the List in to-do mode, which adds Slack's built-in task-tracking columns (such as assignee, due date, and completion status) so the List behaves as a task tracker.
todo_mode.human_parameter_description: Turn on task-tracking mode, which adds built-in columns like assignee, due date, and completion status.

copy_from_list_id.title: Copy From List Id
copy_from_list_id.description: ID of an existing Slack List to copy the structure from, e.g. 'F0123456789'. When provided, the new List is created with the same columns as that List. Use `include_copied_list_records` to also copy its rows.
copy_from_list_id.human_parameter_description: The ID of an existing List to copy the column structure from, instead of defining columns yourself.

description_blocks.title: Description Blocks
description_blocks.description: Rich text describing the List, shown beneath the title. Slack stores this as Block Kit `rich_text` blocks. For convenience you may pass a plain string (it is wrapped into a `rich_text` block automatically), a single block dict (wrapped in a list), or an already-formed list of blocks (passed through unchanged). Omit to create a List with no description.
description_blocks.human_parameter_description: A description for the List. You can just type plain text, or pass Block Kit rich_text blocks if you want formatting.

include_copied_list_records.title: Include Copied List Records
include_copied_list_records.description: When copying from another List via `copy_from_list_id`, set to true to also copy that List's existing items (rows) into the new List. Has no effect unless `copy_from_list_id` is set.
include_copied_list_records.human_parameter_description: When copying from another List, also copy its existing rows (not just the columns).
